{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column: it's stored as string
print("Data type of revenue:", df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Unique values in revenue:", df['revenue'].unique())

# Check if any row has revenue == '999999.99'
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {len(qa_rows)}")

# Check if any row has revenue as float 999999.99
# First, convert revenue to float to check
try:
    df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    qa_rows_float = df[df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
    print(f"Number of rows with revenue_float == 999999.99: {len(qa_rows_float)}")
    print(qa_rows_float[['order_id', 'status', 'revenue', 'revenue_float']])
except Exception as e:
    print("Error converting revenue to float:", e)"}
